_note: Faith and Spirituality catalogue additions. Real titles come from docs/research/faith-titles.json (27 verified) plus two other-tradition classics verified here for Quiet Contemplation. Fictional authors and titles are demo only. Codes are provisional, minted with packages/schema/src/codes.ts rule using keys 'faith:<slug>' (workbooks) and '<slug>' (authors), checked against existing codes. No existing catalogue workbook is a faith title, so existing_ids are empty.

conventions.genre: Existing hyphenated catalogue genres, mapped from taxonomy.json; a 'faith' genre is an open question [Crent].
conventions.safety_profile: 'wellbeing_standard' is used for schema safety tier 'standard' so the loader treats it like other Help now titles; safety_tier repeats the schema value.
conventions.scripture_text: WEBBE for en-GB, WEB for en-US, WEBBE with Deuterocanon for Catholic and Orthodox titles; en-AU, en-CA and en-NZ marked [check]. Classics keep their own embedded quotations.
conventions.support_signpost: 'bereavement_support_lines' is a new value and needs support_lines.json entries by market [check].
